children: Cigarette company Altria said it was considering a takeover offer to buy London-listed peer Imperial Brands.

The U.S. tobacco and nicotine company said Thursday that any offer would be in cash and that it was also in talks with a third party to buy part of Imperial Brands if any deal went ahead. However, it said no agreement had been reached.
Altria didn't provide any financial details of the potential offer or on the third party.
Imperial Brands didn't immediately respond to a request for comment.
In early afternoon trading, Imperial Brands shares were up 14% at 34.47 pounds, a price not seen since July 2017, and leading the FTSE 100 index risers.
Shares jumped earlier Thursday after Bloomberg reported that Japan Tobacco was interested in making a move for the British company.
